This appears to be a (in parts oddly-worded) weak copyleft-style license, specifically for use with mods for Minecraft. The example projects specified in the submission do indicate sufficiently widespread usage within that community, in my opinion.

The typos in the license text appear to be consistent across the given examples, so I would suggest keeping them as-is.

I note from GitHub searches that there do appear to be other versions of the license in use, with different version numbers (e.g. 2.0.3 at https://github.com/K-4U/Hydraulicraft/blob/87a4b65df97b6d30ca29deccd0c06e3564e455da/LICENSE.md?plain=1#L4). That's fine, and maybe those will be submitted and evaluated separately at some point in the future. Just noting that here in case they do get submitted at some point.
+1 to add.  Would prefer fixing the typos in markdown.  Name is fine.
